title: Hawaii Revised Statutes, Chapter 388 — Payment of Wages and Other Compensation
verified_how: register page could not be fetched (HTTP 403, Cloudflare block). Chapter number and title corroborated from the Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Wage Standards Division page (https://labor.hawaii.gov/wsd/), which states: 'Chapter 388, HRS, Payment of Wages and Other Compensation Law, requires employers to pay the earned wages of all employees at least twice a month...'.
notes: in_force 'unclear': the register is blocked and no state source I could reach gives an in-force or as-at statement. The minimum wage and overtime sit in the companion Chapter 387 (Wage and Hour Law), likewise corroborated from the same DLIR page.
